biography:
Garry Townsend's journey began not on a racetrack, but on the windswept coast of Norfolk, England, where his father ran a small boat repair shop. The roar of boat engines was the soundtrack to his childhood, and the precision required for marine engineering instilled in him a deep respect for mechanical mastery. At age 10, a family friend introduced him to karting, and Garry was immediately hooked. He quickly demonstrated an uncanny ability to read the track and adapt his line with remarkable consistency, earning podium finishes in local championships. His talent caught the eye of Cobra Force Racing during a regional karting event. 

Cobra Force, impressed by Garry's smooth driving style and innate understanding of vehicle dynamics, signed him to their junior development program at the tender age of 17. His transition to single-seaters was seamless. He spent two years honing his skills in Formula Ford, before graduating to Formula 3. 

His inaugural Formula 3 season saw him score a stunning victory at Silverstone, showcasing his exceptional racecraft and composure under pressure. His performance put the rest of the paddock on notice. 

Currently, Garry is competing in his second Formula 3 season with Cobra Force, aiming to solidify his position as a future star. While consistent points finishes have been the norm, he's hungry for more wins and a serious championship challenge.
drivingStyle: Garry's driving style is characterized by its remarkable smoothness and consistency. He's not one for flamboyant overtakes or aggressive maneuvers. Instead, he focuses on maintaining momentum through corners and preserving tire life. He has a knack for managing pressure. While others might crack under the weight of expectation, Garry seems to thrive, becoming even more focused and precise. He is known to be a calculating driver, often waiting for the opportune moment to strike rather than forcing an overtake, earning him the nickname 'The Norfolk Navigator'.

careerHighlight: Winning the Silverstone Formula 3 race in his rookie season. He started from P5 and executed a brilliant strategy, overtaking the leaders in the closing laps to secure a memorable victory.
